Rotate from BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX toward gold and uranium names

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 (^AXJO) likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. RBA hawkish bias, elevated oil, and property stress cap upside. Gold and energy names outperform; banks and property lag. Expect volatility around RBA communications and geopolitical headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Structural iron ore weakness, property correction risk, and living standards squeeze weigh on broad market. Gold, uranium, and energy offer relative strength. A rate peak and property stabilisation could unlock a recovery by H2 2027.
